summary: Completed backend API and desktop/mobile browser verification for the landing page, navigation, showcase, theme, contact flow, and back-to-top behavior.
action_items: Review the Technology Stack section: it labels the database as SQLite while the implemented contact API uses MongoDB.
critical_code_review_comments: The UI technology stack copy is inconsistent with the actual backend persistence technology (SQLite displayed, MongoDB configured and used).
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST/browser QA contact messages through the public contact API during verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page, desktop/mobile responsiveness, nav anchors, Live Demo, showcase tab switching, dark mode, mobile menu, contact POST/success, API validation/serialization, back-to-top, overflow, and console/error selectors were verified.
rca of the issue: No runtime defects reproduced. The only actionable review finding is content-level: frontend/src/App.js advertises SQLite in StackAndBenefits while backend/server.py loads MongoDB via MONGO_URL and writes contact_messages there.
